args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (0.18) since its deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks in all production regions after the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Current status showed v2.3.1 deployed to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and unhealthy. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** — checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Rollback verified as `rolled_out`.
3. **Opened incident** — Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the current release candidate issue — the incident is open for the on-call engineer to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before any re-deploy attempt.
